verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents a gddy agent skill that lets you ask your AI agent in plain language to find a domain, check pricing, register it, or update DNS, with the agent running real gddy commands under your authenticated session. Its official MCP server also lets AI assistants search domains and check availability from a conversation, and the search API accepts natural-language queries. Missing for 10: natural-language operation depends on a third-party AI agent rather than a first-party interface, the MCP server only covers search and availability, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflows work as claimed.
